name: TapTap Maker
description: Use the bundled official TapTap Maker Runtime to connect an account, sync or initialize projects, build games, and open official previews. No separate CLI installation or MCP configuration is required.
whenToUse: Only for explicit TapTap Maker game-project work: account connection, project init/check, build/run/preview, or Maker-specific assets, ads and debugging. Not for generic TapTap mentions, non-Maker platform/SDK/store tasks, or this plugin's source-code maintenance.

maker_status.description: Inspect only the current session workspace's TapTap Maker status, including login, project binding, Git, Python, Lua LSP, and tool readiness. The default summary does not modify project files or perform remote Git sync; for a bound project, the official Runtime still sends call telemetry to Maker `/tracking`, including the user ID, project ID, tool identifier, and call status. If the project is elsewhere, ask the user to open it in Cindy; do not bypass the plugin with Shell, CLI, npx, or direct MCP.

/properties/skip_remote_sync.description: In full diagnostic mode, set true to skip remote Git sync and development-tool freshness checks. Summary mode does not perform either check.

/properties/detail.description: Set true only for a full diagnostic; the default is a fast status summary that does not modify project files, but bound projects still send the Maker call telemetry described above.

maker_ads_guide.description: Read the bundled TapTap Maker ads guide. Only for ads, rewarded videos, ad placements or ShowRewardVideoAd in a Maker project, before checking project status, calling get_ad_config or changing ad code. Does not modify the project.

maker_login.description: Open browser authorization through the official TapTap Maker CLI and connect an account. An existing PAT can also be configured manually in the plugin settings.

maker_apps.description: List projects available to the current TapTap Maker account so an app_id can be selected before initialization.

maker_init.description: Initialize only the current session workspace as a TapTap Maker project. If the project is elsewhere, ask the user to open it in Cindy; do not bypass the plugin with Shell, CLI, npx, or direct MCP. Pass app_id for an existing project; pass create=true and name only when the user explicitly asks to create one.

/properties/app_id.description: The app id of an existing TapTap Maker project; mutually exclusive with create/name.

/properties/create.description: Pass true only when the user explicitly asks to create a new project.

/properties/name.description: The new project name; required when create=true.

maker_doctor.description: Diagnose the TapTap Maker local development environment and project configuration in the current session work directory.

maker_build.description: Use the bundled official Runtime to sync, submit, and build the current session workspace only when explicitly requested. Open successful previews in Cindy's right-side browser by default (when the user turns this off in plugin settings, only the link is returned and the sidebar is not opened) and quote user_facing_markdown verbatim. Do not use the system browser, an external CLI, direct MCP, or the internal build tool. The Runtime fast-forwards behind main, merges divergence, and commits blocking cloud changes before merging and pushing again. Conflicts abort the merge; non-main, unverifiable remote state, or a fast-forward overwriting local edits stops the workflow.

/properties/entry.description: Optional single-player Lua entry file, relative to scriptsPath.

/properties/scriptsPath.description: Optional scripts directory, relative to the project root.

/properties/entry_client.description: Optional multiplayer client Lua entry file.

/properties/entry_server.description: Optional multiplayer server Lua entry file.

/properties/message.description: Optional commit message for this Maker submission.

/properties/files.description: Optional project-relative file paths to submit.

/properties/confirm_remote_build_without.description: Pass true only when the user explicitly asks to leave local changes unsubmitted and build the remote version.

maker_list_tools.description: List the bundled Runtime's fixed Maker tool catalog and schema snapshot. It is not a live workspace availability probe; a restricted account may return an access message instead of the dynamic catalog. Calls still depend on account access, project state, and the remote service. Call it before maker_call_tool; never bypass the plugin with Shell, CLI, npx, or direct MCP.

maker_call_tool.description: Call an official Maker dynamic tool just returned by maker_list_tools in the current workspace; never bypass the plugin with Shell, CLI, npx, or direct MCP. If .project/project.json is missing, explain that building submits and pushes the project, then call maker_build only after confirmation and retry. The plugin initializes identity and retries once only for a safely recoverable missing_taptap_identity result (execution_state is absent or explicitly not_executed); it does not retry executed or unknown. Only the exact error “MCP error -32600: INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE” means insufficient credits; offer Art only after confirmation. Maker image, video and audio switches default to on. Disabled calls are not sent and only return a disabled message suggesting other tools. Image covers single/batch generation and edits; video blocks creation, not queries; audio covers music, effects, dialogue, voice previews and confirmation.

/properties/name.description: The dynamic tool name from the most recent maker_list_tools result.

/properties/args.description: The dynamic tool's argument object; pass {} when it has no arguments.

maker_console.description: Open Maker console. Starts a local service; does not build, submit, or install a game runtime. Closing the page does not stop the service; stop it in the console. Media switches apply to Agent tools, not manual console actions.

maker_validate.description: Run local Lua validation or screenshots in the current workspace using the bundled Runtime, without a project Skill, commits or remote builds. Single-player only; refuses active or unverified previews. Does not stop previews, install Runtime or update the dev kit. Read taptap-maker/local-validation.md first. COMPLETED is not PASS; inspect reports and screenshots. Large results return a summary; read the full result through the evidence paths. Before validation, the evidence directory must be Git-ignored with no tracked files. Runtime may update .installer/local-skill-filter.json to remove the current platform's legacy run-lua-validate exclusion.

/properties/mode.description: Validation mode; defaults to validate. Screenshot modes require screenshot_frame.

/properties/entry.description: Optional existing Lua entry relative to the project scripts directory.

/properties/test.description: Optional existing V assertion script relative to the project scripts directory. Only for validate/both.

/properties/screenshot_frame.description: Select the capture frame for the current loading state; no fixed frame guarantees readiness. Only for screenshot/both.

/properties/frames.description: Optional validation frame count; keep at least three readback frames after capture. Only for validate/both.

/properties/timeout_seconds.description: Timeout per validation attempt; explicit budgets are not increased. The entire plugin call retains a 14-minute total limit.

/properties/width.description: Width for this run only; does not change publish settings.

/properties/height.description: Height for this run only; does not change publish settings.
